assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for an original top-down 2D roguelite named Yichuan Princess Rescue. Cohesive detailed 16-bit pixel art, charming chibi proportions, strong dark navy outlines, warm ivory highlights, mint teal and amber palette, crisp intentional pixel clusters, no blurry painterly shading. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN camera looking down at 45 degrees, NEVER side-scroller profile, NEVER isometric diamond ground. Every sprite is fully isolated with generous transparent padding. No lettering, no labels, no panel borders, no drawn grid lines, no watermark. True transparent alpha background. Exact equal-sized grid, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Consistent character scale and baseline. Asset: a 4-column by 4-row animation sprite atlas, square 1024x1024. Exactly 16 sprites of the SAME orange and cream Shiba Inu samurai hero Yichuan, cute serious eyebrows, red scarf, indigo samurai armor, tiny straw backpack. UNARMED so separate weapons can orbit him, no sword in his hands. Four-frame walk cycles with moderate pose differences, stable head size and silhouette. Row 1: facing right, four walking poses. Row 2: facing away/up, four walking poses, clearly showing back of head and backpack. Row 3: facing left, four walking poses. Row 4: facing toward viewer/down, four walking poses. Big readable head, stubby legs, visible top of head and shoulders. Fully transparent surrounding every individual figure.
